title: Repository checks
what: The repository rules held as tests of the root package: no Hangul, no personal data, the contract naming nothing of its callers, the committed contract being generated, the layout and the dependencies.

title: Deployment
what: How bmo-testbed deploys the repository: the release and its binary, the settings linked from the data root, the user unit running bmo-job serve, and what gates a deployment.

title: HTTP server
what: The routes mounted over the store behind the bearer token, and the path, query and body read into each route type, a request of the wrong shape answered bad-request.

title: Running the service
what: Starting the service: the settings read, the store opened, the listener bound, the sweep and delivery started beside the routes, and the graceful stop on a signal.

title: Settings
what: The one TOML settings file the service reads at start: where it listens, the file holding its bearer token, and the SQLite database it keeps its members in.

title: Store and schema
what: The one SQLite store every change runs through, its tables and the rules they keep, the schema version refused where it differs, and the clock it reads.

title: The sweep
what: The once-a-second work that ends leases and holds, expires subscriptions, tells questions that have come due, and drops events past the window.
